# AccountingTools

> AccountingTools provides NASBA-approved CPE courses and continuing professional education for accounting professionals seeking CPA credits.

AccountingTools specializes in delivering accredited continuing professional education (CPE) courses tailored for CPAs and accounting professionals. The platform offers NASBA-approved training in GAAP, tax, audit, and emerging technologies like Excel and AI tools.

## Key Topics

- CPE (Continuing Professional Education)
- NASBA Approval
- CPA Credits
- GAAP
- Tax Training
- Audit Training
- Excel
- Microsoft Copilot
- Accounting Education
- Professional Development
- Course Catalog
- Continuing Education Credits
- Artificial Intelligence
- Accounting Training
- Learning Platform

## CPE Courses & Training

- [AccountingTools Home Page](https://cpe.accountingtools.com/home): NASBA-approved CPE courses for accounting professionals and CPA credit
- [Courses Sorted by Hours](https://cpe.accountingtools.com/courses-sorted-by-hours): Browse CPE courses by duration with GAAP, tax, and audit training
- [Latest Courses](https://cpe.accountingtools.com/latest-courses): Latest CPE courses including Excel and Microsoft Copilot training
